tasks: Feature details: an accordion for a product page that expands one feature and keeps the other summaries easy to scan.
Preview zoom: a slider for an image editor that changes magnification while keeping the selected area in view.
Save notice: a toast for a project editor that confirms a save and then clears without blocking the work.
Item quantity: a stepper for a shopping cart that changes item count and updates the total.
Product rating: a rating control for a shop that lets someone select a score and change it before saving.
Workspace search: a search field for a team app that filters project names and shows when nothing matches.
Booking date: a date picker for an appointment prototype that selects an available day and shows the choice.
Upload progress: a progress ring for a media tool that shows how much of a file has uploaded and when it finishes.
Result pages: pagination for a content library that moves through results and marks the current page.
Folder trail: breadcrumbs for a file browser that show the current folder and let someone return to a parent.
Copy invite: a copy button for a team app that copies an invite link and confirms success.
Password reveal: a password field for a signup prototype that switches between hidden and visible text without losing input.
Content tags: a tag input for a publishing tool that adds, edits, and removes labels from a draft.
Brand color: a color picker for a site builder that changes the accent color in a live preview.
Loading preview: a skeleton for a project gallery that holds the card layout while sample content loads.
First project: an empty state for a workspace that explains the next action and lets someone create a first project.
Launch countdown: a countdown for a product launch page that shows time remaining and changes state when the launch arrives.
View switch: a segmented control for a project library that switches between list, grid, and compact views.
Task selection: a checkbox for a task list that selects one task or shows a partly selected group.
Board order: a reorder list for a planning board that moves tasks and makes their new order clear.
Team members: an avatar stack for a project header that shows collaborators and reveals the people hidden in the count.
Unread count: a badge for an inbox that updates when messages arrive or someone marks them read.
Activity trend: a sparkline for a product dashboard that shows a short activity history and reveals a selected value.
Undo edit: an undo control for a canvas editor that restores the previous change and shows what came back.
Save button: an action button for an editor that shows pending work, confirms success and offers retry after a sample failure.
Download button: a button for a file panel that shows preparation, completion and a repeat action in a local demo.
Destructive action: a delete button for a project card that asks for confirmation and offers undo after removal.
Split action: a split button for a publishing tool that offers save, schedule and draft choices with clear state feedback.
Request loader: a loader for a content panel that moves from pending to loaded or failed, with retry and stable layout.
Import stages: a loader for a file tool that shows named stages, allows cancel and ends in a clear completion state.
Details panel: a side panel for a project tool that opens from a card, edits a title and returns focus when closed.
Share sheet: a bottom panel for a media tool that copies a link, reports failure and closes with a swipe, button or key.
Filter panel: a panel for a library that applies and clears filters while showing the resulting item count.
Project card: a card for a workspace that opens useful details and lets someone pin or archive the sample project.
Metric card: a card for a service dashboard that changes time range and reveals the selected metric value.
Plan card: a card for a pricing page that changes billing period and clearly marks the selected plan.
Latency chart: a chart card for a service dashboard that selects a time range and reveals latency at a chosen point.
Pipeline panel: a status panel for a build tool that expands a failed step, shows its log and retries it in a local demo.
Log viewer: a panel for a developer tool that filters sample events by severity and opens the chosen event details.
Data table: a compact table for a project tool that sorts rows, selects an item and shows a useful empty state.

tasks: Toggle in risograph: two ink layers slip out of register as it flips, then lock back into one clean print.
Slider in sediment: each step lays down a stratum, and dragging back scrapes the layers away.
Button in letterpress: the press bites into paper, and the deboss stays as proof it was pressed.
Loader in phosphor: a trace writes the wait across a dark screen, and the glow fades behind the beam.
Progress ring in phyllotaxis: seeds spiral out from the center until the head is full.
Dial in cymatics: turning changes the tone, and sand gathers on the nodal lines when it locks.
Stepper in split flap: each count clatters through the flaps and settles on the new number.
Rating in thermal: a press leaves a warm print that cools to the score that was given.
Countdown in marbled ink: rings of ink spread on water and close in as the moment nears.
Tooltip in frost: a hint crystallizes where the hand pauses and melts when it moves on.
Tabs in folded paper: panels crease and refold so the one in front always lies flat.
Accordion in bellows: a section draws breath as it opens, and the last one breathes out.
Toast in smoke: a notice rises, holds its shape long enough to read, and drifts apart.
Segmented control in iron filings: a magnet slides between three choices and the filings follow.
Checkbox in embroidery: a stitch crosses the box, can be unpicked, or stops halfway as a half state.
Search field in a sieve: letters shake a mesh, and only the matching words stay on top.
Date picker in tide: drag the tide line along a shore of days, and it leaves one day wet.
Copy button in carbon paper: one tap presses a copy through, and the second sheet shows it worked.
Password field in crystal growth: each character feeds a crystal that grows larger and more ordered.
Tag input in beads: each word becomes a bead on a thread, and a tap slips one off the end.
Color swatch in dye bath: dip the cloth, and it slowly takes one color from a small set of vats.
Skeleton in graphite rubbing: the shape of the content appears as if rubbed over a hidden relief.
Empty state in tide pool: an empty list is a still pool with one small creature waiting.
Reorder list in rope: items hang on a rope, and lifting one moves the slack along the line.
Undo in rewind: a mistake runs back along its own path, the way tape plays in reverse.
Key hint in ripples: each key on screen sends one ring across still water when it is pressed.
Character counter in sand: grains drain as text is typed, showing how much room is left.
Theme switch in eclipse: light and dark trade places as one disc slides across another.
File drop in a well: a dropped file falls, rings spread, and the echo confirms it arrived.
Scroll progress in a wick: a thin flame burns along the edge as the page is read.
Split view in surface tension: two pools share one edge that the hand can drag.
Carousel in a zoetrope: cards spin past a slit and stop one at a time, by swipe or key.
Status dot in fireflies: one light pulses slowly when away, steadily when online, and fast when busy.
Command menu in magnetism: typing pulls the matching actions up out of a scattered field.
Badge in droplets: the count grows as drops merge, and a drop splits off when it goes down.
Sparkline in seismograph: a needle draws the numbers inside a sentence and settles at rest.
Initials stack in shadow play: a few figures overlap behind a screen, and the rest are a count.
Pagination in flipbook: pages riffle under the thumb and stop with the number in view.
Breadcrumb in footprints: the trail back up is a line of prints that deepen as each is reached.
Slider in pendulum: a weighted bob swings to the value and slowly comes to rest.
